title: Counter
description: Numeric counter component for displaying notifications, item counts, metrics, and other indicators in a compact format.
intro: The Counter component displays numeric indicators (notification counters, item counts, metrics, etc.) in a compact format. It supports multiple value display variants: regular counter (count), plus format when threshold is exceeded (count-plus), and shortened notation in thousands (count-k), controlled by variant and plusLimit props.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Counter is a flexible component for displaying numeric indicators in your application. It automatically handles:

features.valueFormatting: Value formatting with multiple variants (count, count-plus, count-k)
features.thresholdControl: Threshold control for plus format (plusLimit prop)
features.compactDisplay: Compact display suitable for use inside other UI elements

props.title: Props
props.value: value (number) — Numeric value to display. Required.
props.plusLimit: plusLimit (number) — Threshold for shortening value to v+ format. For example, 1500 -> 999+ for 1000. Default: 10.
props.htmlAttributes: ...HTMLDivAttributes — All standard div HTML attributes are supported.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.semantic: Semantic HTML structure ensures screen reader compatibility
accessibility.attributes: Component accepts all standard HTML attributes for customization
accessibility.readable: Numeric values are readable text, providing meaningful information

bestPractices.title: Best practices
bestPractices.appropriateVariants: Use appropriate variants — Choose count, count-plus, or count-k based on your use case
bestPractices.setPlusLimit: Set plusLimit appropriately — Configure the threshold based on your data range
bestPractices.consistentSizes: Consistent size usage — Match counter size to context and importance
bestPractices.considerContrast: Consider contrast — Ensure counter values are readable against background colors
bestPractices.useInContext: Use in context — Counter is designed to be used inside other UI elements (buttons, tags, menu items)
bestPractices.handleLargeValues: Handle large values — Use count-k variant for values over 1000 to keep display compact
